skill.name: resume-bullet-writer
skill.description: Rewrite resume bullets to highlight your actions, results, and measurable impact. Get follow-up questions when a draft lacks detail.
skill.summary: Turn job duties and project notes into concise resume bullets for a target role.
skill.author: paramchoudhary

security_audit.summary: All 13 static alerts are false positives: the flagged text contains Markdown fences, resume questions, and writing guidance. No evidence of command execution, reconnaissance, or prompt injection was found. Some examples add resume claims that the stated inputs do not support.

remediation.issue: Some examples add metrics or results without support from their stated inputs.
remediation.suggestion: Ask users to confirm each new figure and claim. If they cannot confirm it, describe the verified action or scope without a metric.

semantic_findings.title: Resume Examples Add Unsupported Claims
semantic_findings.description: The social media rewrite adds a count of 15 partnerships that the stated inputs omit. The career change example adds a 100% project completion rate. Following these examples could cause applicants to submit claims they cannot substantiate.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The new figures appear in the rewritten bullets but not in the examples' stated inputs. This shows a risk of inaccurate claims without establishing intent to mislead.

content.user_title: Write Resume Bullets That Show Results
content.value_statement: A list of duties does not show what you achieved. Rewrite each bullet to show what you did, why it mattered, and which results you can verify.
actual_capabilities: Rewrite duty statements with active verbs and specific accomplishments.
Structure bullets around an action, its context, and the result using STAR, CAR, or X-Y-Z.
Ask for missing details such as your contribution, project scope, and measurable outcomes.
Tailor wording and emphasis to a target role or industry.
Show the original bullet, identify its weaknesses, and explain the revision.
limitations: The skill cannot verify employment history, outcomes, or figures.
Sparse notes may need follow-up before they support a specific result.
The skill does not build or format a complete resume.
Some source examples add figures not present in their inputs. Verify any new claim before using it.

use_cases.title: Write a First Resume
use_cases.description: Turn coursework, internships, or volunteer projects into bullets that show your contribution.

use_cases.title: Update a Resume for Promotion
use_cases.description: Replace routine job duties with examples of leadership, larger responsibilities, and documented results.

use_cases.title: Show Transferable Experience
use_cases.description: Highlight relevant skills from a previous industry without changing what you did or achieved.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite One Bullet
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this resume bullet with a clear action verb: [draft]. Use only the facts I provide.

prompt_templates.title: Find the Missing Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these notes: [notes]. Ask what I did, what changed, and how I measured it before drafting a bullet.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Develop a bullet from incomplete notes.

prompt_templates.title: Show a Verified Result
prompt_templates.prompt: Use X-Y-Z to rewrite [draft] using [action] and [verified result]. Explain what changed and omit any claim my notes do not support.

prompt_templates.title: Tailor Bullets to a Target Role
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise these bullets for [target role] using [draft bullets] and [role priorities]. Keep team results distinct from my contributions and flag unsupported claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Compare several bullets against a new role.

output_examples.input: Original: Processed invoices. I built a review checklist that reduced weekly invoice review time from five hours to three.
output_examples.output: Reduced weekly invoice review time from five hours to three by creating a review checklist.

output_examples.input: I scheduled and led onboarding sessions for four new volunteers. We did not track retention or performance.
output_examples.output: Scheduled and led onboarding sessions for four new volunteers.

best_practices: Provide your original bullet, your specific contribution, and the outcome.
Give the target role so the revision can emphasize relevant experience.
Check every figure against a reliable source before using it.
anti_patterns: Adding a percentage because the bullet has no number.
Claiming sole credit for a team result.
Using a stronger verb that overstates your responsibility.

faq.question: Can I use this without exact numbers?
faq.answer: Yes. Describe the scope or outcome you can verify, even if you cannot express it as a number.

faq.question: Can I use coursework or volunteer experience?
faq.answer: Yes. Describe what you contributed to a project and what happened as a result.

faq.question: What is the X-Y-Z format?
faq.answer: It states what you achieved, how you measured it, and what action produced the result.

faq.question: Can it tailor my bullets to a job description?
faq.answer: Yes. Share the role priorities and your current bullets so the rewrite can emphasize experience relevant to the job.

faq.question: Does it verify figures or results?
faq.answer: No. Confirm all figures and outcomes yourself before putting them on your resume.

faq.question: Will I get a complete resume?
faq.answer: No. The skill writes and revises individual bullets. You choose where to place them in your resume.
